_comment: The cast. Each voice is DESIGNED once from its description (VoiceStudio + VoxCPM2) into tools/voice/refs/<id>.wav, then every line of that speaker is cloned from it, so the voice stays the same across the whole story. Change a description + delete its ref wav to recast.

boss.name: O CHEFÃO
boss.design: A Brazilian man in his late fifties, a crime boss. Deep, low, gravelly and husky voice, slow and calm, confident and menacing, speaking Brazilian Portuguese with a São Paulo accent.
boss.ref_text: Escuta aqui, meu amigo. Nessa cidade, quem manda sou eu. E quem não entende isso, não dura muito tempo.

you.name: VOCÊ
you.design: A Brazilian man around thirty years old, a street-smart hustler. Clear medium-pitched voice, casual and a bit sarcastic, relaxed pace, speaking Brazilian Portuguese with a Rio de Janeiro accent.
you.ref_text: Olha, eu não sei quem você é, mas eu tô precisando de dinheiro. Então fala logo o que você quer.

priest.name: PADRE ANSELMO
priest.design: An old Brazilian priest in his seventies. Soft, warm, slightly shaky voice, slow and solemn like a sermon, speaking Brazilian Portuguese with a countryside accent from Minas Gerais.
priest.ref_text: Meu filho, a fé move montanhas. Ajoelhe-se, reze, e o Senhor vai te mostrar o caminho.

crowd.name: O POVO
crowd.design: A Brazilian woman in her forties from a small village, loud, emotional and overjoyed, almost shouting with gratitude, speaking Brazilian Portuguese.
crowd.ref_text: Graças a Deus! Ele salvou a gente! Obrigada, meu Deus, obrigada!

woman.name: MULHER
woman.design: A Brazilian woman around twenty-five years old. Bright, warm, natural voice, friendly and lively, speaking Brazilian Portuguese with a São Paulo accent.
woman.ref_text: Oi! Tudo bem com você? Faz tempo que eu não te vejo por aqui na cidade.

child.name: CRIANÇA
child.design: A Brazilian boy about eight years old. High-pitched, innocent, energetic child's voice, speaking Brazilian Portuguese.
child.ref_text: Moço, moço! Você viu minha bola? Ela caiu lá do outro lado da rua!
